subject: Vendr onboarding: QnA triage & evidence bridge
messages:
From: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr onboarding: QnA triage & evidence bridge

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for agreeing to get Bluecrest Health set up in Vendr. We're starting the portal intake and have a couple of asks to make the upload smooth:

1) Please complete the attached SIG spreadsheet (we only need answered cells and any supporting artifacts). If you prefer a TAR/ZIP of evidence, let us know and we'll accept an S3 presign link.
2) We need your latest SOC 2 cert + summary of scoping (Prod / Staging separation) so we can map controls.
3) Can you attach a simple network architecture diagram showing public ingress, VPC peering (if any), and dataplane (KV caches, model artifacts S3)? A PNG is fine.

Requested timeline: Can you get initial answers and artifacts by EOD Friday (2027-08-20)? If you need help triaging which questions require engineering input vs. security-owner answers, we can run a 30-min triage call.

Attachments: SIG-template-answers.xlsx (spreadsheet outline)

Thanks,
Sam (on behalf of Vendr Portal Intake)
Vendr Security
security@vendr.com

---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, michael_grant@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-14T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: QnA triage & evidence bridge

Hi Sam — thanks for the note. We're starting a slim intake path to avoid back-and-forth on low-risk items. Plan below:

- I will upload the completed SIG answers (authoritative responses) and our SOC2 cert by Thursday EOD (2027-08-19).
- Rishi will handle any infra/network questions — Michael will attach the network diagram and a short readme describing our VPC layout and S3 buckets.
- If Vendr needs sample logs for a control, we'll provide a redacted syslog sample and a pointer to where audit logs are retained (retention policy).

Attachments (will attach in follow-up): redwood-soc2-cert-2026.pdf, SIG-template-answers-v1.xlsx, network-architecture-diagram.png

Request: please indicate which SIG sections you plan to verify first (Data Protection, Access Control, Change Mgmt). If Vendr can pre-select the 10 highest-priority sub-controls, we will accelerate those.

Marissa Cole
Head of Vendor Security Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: michael_grant@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-14T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: QnA triage & evidence bridge

Marissa — quick checklist from infra side:

- Michael: can you export the diagram as both PNG and a short text summary (3 bullets) describing the KV cache lifecycle and where model artifacts live? That'll answer most SIG data-flow questions.
- I'll pre-fill the SIG control rows that are purely policy (IAM review cadence, quarterly pentest cadence, KMS key rotation windows).
- For anything flagged as evidence requiring logs, we will provide a 7-day sample with IPs redacted.

If Vendr needs to escalate a control (e.g., encryption-at-rest details), ask them to open a portal ticket and tag it priority: "security-triage" so we can route to infra SRE quickly.

-rishi

Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: QnA triage & evidence bridge

Marissa / team — appreciate the quick plan. A couple clarifications before you upload so we can route items properly in the portal: 

- We will prioritize these SIG sections: 1) Data Protection (encryption, KMS), 2) Access Control (IAM + RBAC), 3) Change Management (deploy pipeline controls).
- For encryption-at-rest: a short config snippet or KMS key policy is sufficient — no need to share full key metadata.
- Network diagram: PNG + 3-bullet readme is perfect.
- For any items you mark as "evidence pending — engineering", create a placeholder in portal with expected delivery date; that helps our tracker.

We created the portal intake ticket: https://vendr.com/portal/onboarding/bluecrest-12345 (you should see it when you upload). If you want a 30-min triage, I'm free 2027-08-16 11:00-11:30 PT.

Attachments referenced: (none — we pulled the SIG template you were sent)

Best,
Samira Khan (Vendr Intake)
Vendr Security
